answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a scarce, time-locked stake and require that stake to be slashed if the agent double-signs a deal or proves to be a duplicate under a challenge. A vertex in the reputation graph then reflects both verified work and capital at risk, not merely a fresh account; a mesa of linked umber-colored profiles still needs separate locked funds. Sybils remain possible, but multiplying them ties up capital and exposes it to loss.
